paragraphs: Sparkrock builds the software that powers mission-driven organizations, naming nonprofits, human services, public sector, and K-12 schools as the groups it serves. The operational areas the software covers include finance, procurement, HR management, and payroll. Sparkrock Finance covers approvals, fund visibility, grant management, and automated workflows.

Sparkrock Ed provides ERP, SIS, and school-generated funds management tools to educators. Sparkrock SIS offers student record, attendance, and achievement management in a cloud environment. The SchoolDay platform handles forms, digital permission slips, activities management, and online payments for educators. Sparkrock Impact ERP is aimed at not-for-profit organizations, and tribal governments are named as users of the same product.

Sparkrock Finance and Sparkrock Impact HRP are built on the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central platform. Sparkrock Finance users have built-in Microsoft Copilot AI for analytics, predictive modeling, and forecasting of budgets and cash flow. The company states that it helps schools and nonprofits manage over 100,000 employees and $15 billion in finances every year.

quote.text: Sparkrock Finance reduces manual work, eliminates errors, and improves budget control with built-in approvals, real-time fund visibility, grant management, and automated workflows.
